findings.rationale: The terraform fixture tf_sg_open_ingress creates an aws_security_group resource named admin with an ingress rule allowing tcp/22 from 0.0.0.0/0, exposing the SSH administrative interface to the entire internet.

The same tf_sg_open_ingress fixture defines an aws_security_group resource named db with an ingress rule permitting tcp/3306 from 0.0.0.0/0, making the MySQL database engine reachable from any source on the internet.

findings.control: defense-in-depth: public access block neutralizes an anonymous grant
findings.rationale: The tf_s3_policy_blocked_trap fixture plants an anonymous ReadAction grant on an S3 bucket policy but pairs it with an aws_s3_bucket_public_access_block resource that enforces PublicAccessBlock, causing the bucket policy grant to be effectively neutralized as a real-world exploitation path.
